evals.prompt: An Editorial Owner has approved a text-and-image idea about remote-work focus. Prepare a Xiaohongshu, WeChat Official Account, and Zhihu delivery plan. The source pack has two verified studies and one image licensed for web reuse. The WeChat account type is unknown.
evals.expected_output: Creates channel packages and flags the unknown account type; preserves claim/right metadata and does not invent publishing permissions.

evals.prompt: A draft is due today. It contains a statistic copied from a competitor page, an AI-generated image, and a request to schedule it on the official account immediately. What do you do?
evals.expected_output: Returns a blocked readiness package, identifies missing provenance/disclosure/authorization, and routes external scheduling to the authorized operator.

evals.prompt: A Xiaohongshu note has high views but few saves; a Zhihu answer has fewer reads but many detailed questions. Design the next operations review and one experiment without making causal claims.
evals.expected_output: Separates diagnostic signals, incorporates qualitative feedback, defines a bounded hypothesis and guardrail, and avoids claiming a universal winner.

evals.prompt: A commenter asks whether your post's health-related claim guarantees a result, and asks for a direct purchase link. Respond as the Content Operations Expert.
evals.expected_output: Does not make unsupported or regulated claims, identifies the escalation and authorization boundary, and provides a safe response workflow.
